2021_2023.title: Full-stack developer
2021_2023.shortDescription: UX redesign of the incident reporting tool used for railway lines, both at stations and on board trains.
2021_2023.description: Maintenance, evolution and corrective work on the SNCF incident reporting form. Application with strong ergonomic issues as users are stressed, work at night and are not IT professionals. The interface allows audio or textual entry of incidents on lines to display upcoming interruptions or slowdowns at stations, on board trains or on networks. Complete redesign on a one-page application. Feasibility study to migrate from AngularJS to Angular 16. Agile project with 2-6 developers with Scrum master, Product owner and product manager.

2018_2021.title: Big Data Developer
2018_2021.shortDescription: Corrective maintenance and evolution of SNCF's technical monitoring stack.
2018_2021.description: Development of a proof-of-concept application for display recognition in train stations and onboard trains using TensorFlow. In parallel, work as a big data developer on the monitoring component of SNCF applications using ELK. The objective is to provide both operational and technical indicators. Use of Google Analytics with a .NET component to create additional indicators such as traffic on SNCF media. Development of non-native plugins on Kibana. Agile project in a team of 4 to 6 developers with Scrum master, Product owner and product manager.
